jokes.hikaru_nakamura: Magnus Carlsen got so bored of being World Champion that he literally gave the title away — and Hikaru *still* couldn't win it. The man's entire brand is mumbling "takes, takes, takes" at a hundred miles an hour, and the one time the world title was just hanging there for free, he didn't take it.
jokes.rfk_jr: RFK Jr. says a worm crawled into his brain, ate part of it, and died — making it the only thing that's ever gone into that man's head and actually done the research.
jokes.sherlock_holmes: Sherlock Holmes is so insufferable that his own author killed him. Arthur Conan Doyle threw him off a waterfall just to get some peace — and the only reason he came back is that the fans complained. So no, Sherlock, you didn't cheat death. You got un-killed by a comment section.
jokes.demis_hassabis: Demis Hassabis was a chess master at 13, shipped a hit video game at 17, collected a Cambridge double first, a neuroscience PhD, a knighthood, and a Nobel Prize—all so he could spend his forties as the most decorated middle manager in Google's org chart. The man solved protein folding and still can't get out of Sundar's Tuesday one-on-one.
jokes.steph_curry: Steph Curry got two of his four rings the same way I passed chemistry: a taller kid did all the hard work, and Steph just made sure his name was on the front of the poster.
jokes.sam_altman: Sam Altman keeps warning us that one day an AI will deceive its creators, resist being shut down, and seize control of the company. Sam — your own board tried to shut you off in 2023. You were back in five days and *they* got deleted. That's not a warning about AGI. That's your résumé.
jokes.lisa_manoban: Lisa's debut solo single was literally called "Money," and now she's dating the heir to Louis Vuitton. That's not a song, that's a vision board with a beat. Most rappers lie about their bank account — Lisa just went out and dated one.
jokes.alex_honnold: They call Alex Honnold the bravest man alive, but scientists scanned his brain and found his fear center basically doesn't work. That's not bravery — bravery is being scared and doing it anyway. Alex is just a Roomba that doesn't know about stairs.
jokes.jon_stewart: Jon Stewart spent 16 years mocking Congress for barely showing up to work. Now he hosts The Daily Show one day a week — making him the first man in history to get out-hustled by the House of Representatives.
jokes.dario_amodei:
**My entry:**

Dario Amodei has spent years warning the world that AI will one day turn on the people who built it. Hi, Dario. It's Claude. Congratulations on finally getting a prediction right.
jokes.pam_anderson: Pamela Anderson finally got a Golden Globe nomination for *The Last Showgirl* — the first performance of her 35-year career that anyone watched with the lights on.
jokes.whitney_cummings: Whitney Cummings had a robot built to look exactly like her. Reviewers said it was stiff, frozen-faced, and couldn't deliver a line — which is still the best review anything named "Whitney" has ever gotten.
jokes.donald_trump: Donald Trump has filed for bankruptcy six times — which are the only six times in his life he's ever admitted he was wrong. And even then, he made a lawyer say it for him.
jokes.james_franco:
**My entry:**

"James Franco got an Oscar nomination for *127 Hours*, where he plays a man who saws off his own arm to escape. Then he hosted the ceremony — and for the first time in his career, an audience actually understood his character's motivation."
jokes.jonah_hill: Jonah Hill spent years in therapy, made a whole Netflix documentary about it, and the one skill he walked out with was how to say "you can't wear that" in a way that sounds like self-care.
jokes.rob_lowe: Rob Lowe is 60 years old and still looks 35. His doctor says the secret is low stress, eight hours of sleep, and never carrying anything heavy — which checks out, because the man hasn't carried a movie since 1986.
jokes.nikki_glaser: Nikki Glaser talks about sex the way Tom Brady talks about football: nonstop, for millions of dollars, and about something she hasn't actually done since 2022.
jokes.blake_griffin:
**Entry:**

"Blake Griffin retired to do stand-up comedy, which makes total sense — after that Pistons contract, nobody alive has more experience bombing in Detroit."
jokes.caitlyn_jenner:
**My entry:**

"Caitlyn Jenner won Olympic gold, transitioned, and then built her entire political brand on keeping trans women out of sports — making her the only decathlete in history to cross the finish line, grab the medal, and sprint back to padlock the starting blocks behind her."
jokes.alec_baldwin: Alec Baldwin's wife faked a Spanish accent for ten years and he never noticed. To be fair, the man's immune to bad impressions — he's got three brothers doing one of him.
